title: Break-Even Point Calculator
description: Calculate how many units you need to sell to cover your fixed costs.

faqs.question: What is the break-even formula?
faqs.answer: Break-even units = Fixed Costs ÷ (Price per Unit − Variable Cost per Unit).

faqs.question: What happens if price is below variable cost?
faqs.answer: Break-even is never reached — each sale loses money regardless of volume.
